title: Enterprise adoption intercept and competitive model signal audit
creator: Riya Patel
description: Objective: Rapidly synthesize signals describing which open and hosted model variants enterprise customers are evaluating, the feature/usecase gaps driving migrations, and practical switching costs (latency, cost, integration). Deliver an actionable audit with prioritized intervention recommendations for Product and Sales.
acceptance_criteria: Inventory of top 12 model variants customers trialing with signal provenance (customer interviews, telemetry, partner intel)

For each model variant: documented deviation from Redwood parity across 6 enterprise axes (latency, cost per 1k tokens, hallucination risk for RAG, function-calling fidelity, embeddings drift, quantization support)
Prioritized list (RICE-style) of 8 interventions (docs, SDK fixes, routing fallbacks, quant profiles, pricing experiment) with estimated effort and impact
Three validated customer quotes / use-case vignettes demonstrating switching triggers
Handoff deck and a short 6-metric dashboard prototype for Console highlighting model-risk and adoption trends
deliverables: CSV inventory of signals and scoring
Console dashboard prototype snapshots and required event schema
research_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): telemetry sweep + CRM tagging to find customers actively testing non-Redwood models. Phase 2 (2 weeks): 8–12 structured interviews with Solutions Engineers, 5 customer product owners, and 3 channel partners. Phase 3 (1 week): synthesize, score interventions, and prepare handoff. Use mixed-methods: qualitative interviews, quantitative usage telemetry, and lightweight pricing experiments where possible.
interview_targets: 3 Solutions Engineers who handled model migrations
2 Sales AEs who lost/retained deals on model choice
3 partner PMs at model vendors / infrastructure partners
data_sources: Console telemetry: model selection, latency percentiles, error rates
Billing traces: token costs by model for top 50 customers
CRM deal notes for churn/renewal conversations
analysis_framework: For each model vendor/variant evaluate across six enterprise axes and produce a model risk & opportunity score. Use RICE-style scoring for interventions: Reach (customers affected), Impact (probability of preventing churn or enabling upsell), Confidence (evidence strength), Effort (engineering + docs). Rank interventions by R*I*C / Effort.
